leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a recursive function to calculate the minimum coins needed for a given amount.
Construct a dynamic programming table to store computed coin change results.
Initialize and manipulate an array to track the minimum coin counts for each sub-amount.
Apply memoization to optimize the recursive coin change solution.
Integrate base cases into the algorithm to handle zero amounts and impossible scenarios.
Configure the algorithm to work with a given set of coin denominations.
Update the dynamic programming solution to return the minimum coin count or -1 for impossible amounts.
